title: Chapter 1: Essential Ideas in Chemistry

እንኳን ወደ Freshman General Chemistry (Chem 1011) የመጀመሪያው ምዕራፍ የመጨረሻ ክፍል በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ክፍል ከ 1.6 Measurement Uncertainty, Accuracy, and Precision እስከ 1.7 Mathematical Treatment of Measurement Results (Dimensional Analysis & Unit Conversions) ያሉትን የምዕራፍ አንድ ማጠቃለያና እጅግ ወሳኝ የፈተና ስሌቶችን በጥልቀትና ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቶች ይዘንላችሁ ቀርበናል:: እስከ መጨረሻው ተከታተሉ👇👇👇

1.6. Measurement Uncertainty, Accuracy, and Precision

Counting is the only type of measurement that is free from uncertainty, provided the number of objects being counted does not change while the count is underway. The result of such a counting measurement is an example of an exact number. Another example of an exact number is a defined quantity (such as 1 ft = 12 in, 1 in = 2.54 cm, or 1 m = 100 cm). Numbers derived from measurements other than counting are inexact numbers because every measurement contains an inherent uncertainty caused by limitations of the measuring device and human estimation.

1. Significant Figures (Sig Figs)

All digits in a measured quantity, including the uncertain last digit, are called significant figures (or significant digits). The significant figures convey the precision of a measuring device.

Rules for Determining Significant Figures:

  1. Non-zero digits are always significant. Example: 24.7 g has 3 significant figures; 1.428 m has 4 significant figures.
  2. Captive (interior) zeros between non-zero digits are always significant. Example: 7003 m has 4 significant figures; 40.05 g has 4 significant figures.
  3. Leading zeros (zeros before the first non-zero digit) are NEVER significant. They merely indicate the position of the decimal point. Example: 0.0025 kg has 2 significant figures; 0.08 m has 1 significant figure.
  4. Trailing zeros (zeros at the end of a number):
    • If a decimal point is explicitly present, trailing zeros ARE significant. Example: 43.00 mL has 4 significant figures; 1.0 g has 2 significant figures.
    • If no decimal point is present, trailing zeros are AMBIGUOUS. To eliminate ambiguity, write the number in scientific notation. Example: 400 is ambiguous, but 4.00 × 102 has 3 significant figures, while 4 × 102 has 1 significant figure.

Significant Figures in Calculations

  1. Addition and Subtraction: The result must be rounded to have the same number of decimal places as the measurement with the fewest decimal places (least precise measurement).
  2. Multiplication and Division: The result must be rounded to have the same number of significant figures as the measurement with the fewest significant figures.

Rounding Rules:

  • If the digit to be dropped is less than 5, drop it and keep the remaining digits unchanged (round down).
  • If the digit to be dropped is 5 or greater, increase the preceding digit by 1 (round up).

Accuracy vs. Precision

A measurement is considered accurate if it yields a result that is very close to the true or accepted value. Precise measurements yield very similar results when repeated in the same manner.

FeatureAccuracy (ትክክለኛነት)Precision (ተደጋገሚነት)
DefinitionCloseness of a measurement to the true or accepted value.Closeness of agreement among several repeated measurements.
Determined byComparison to a standard or true value.Comparison of multiple trial measurements to each other.
Error TypeAffected by Systematic errors (flaws in equipment or design).Affected by Random errors (uncontrollable variations).

👉 Exact numbers የሚባሉት በቁጠባ (Counting) ወይም በትርጉም (Definition) የሚገኙና ወሰን የሌለው Significant Figure ያላቸው ናቸው:: Inexact (Measured) numbers ደግሞ በለካ የሚገኙና ሁልጊዜም እርግጠኛ አለመሆን (Uncertainty) አለባቸው:: Significant Figures ለመቁጠር፦ ከዜሮ ውጪ ያሉ ቁጥሮች እና በመሃል ያሉ ዜሮዎች ሁልጊዜ ይቆጠራሉ፤ በፊት የሚመጡ ዜሮዎች (Leading zeros) ፈጽሞ አይቆጠሩም፤ ከበስተኋላ ያሉ ዜሮዎች (Trailing zeros) የሚቆጠሩት የዲሲማል ነጥብ (.) ካለ ብቻ ነው:: በድመራ/ቀነሳ ዝቅተኛ Decimal Place ያለው ይመረጣል፤ በብዛት/ክፍፍል ዝቅተኛ Significant Figure ያለው ይመረጣል:: Accuracy ከእውነተኛው እሴት (True value) ጋር መቀራረብ ሲሆን፣ Precision ደግሞ የተደጋገሙ ልኬቶች እርስ በእርስ መቀራረብ ነው::

1.7. Mathematical Treatment of Measurement Results

The factor-label method (also known as dimensional analysis) is a versatile mathematical approach used for unit conversions and problem-solving in chemistry. It is based on the premise that the quantities in a problem are multiplied by unit conversion factors equal to 1.

Conversion Factors

A conversion factor is a ratio of two equivalent quantities expressed with different measurement units. For example, since 1 inch = 2.54 cm, we can form two conversion factors:

(2.54 cm / 1 in) = 1    or    (1 in / 2.54 cm) = 1

Given Quantity × (Desired Unit / Given Unit) = Desired Quantity

Temperature Conversions and Scales

Temperature can be measured on three main scales: Celsius (°C), Kelvin (K), and Fahrenheit (°F). The relationships between these scales are derived from their respective freezing and boiling points of water:

  • Water Freezing Point: 0 °C = 273.15 K = 32 °F
  • Water Boiling Point: 100 °C = 373.15 K = 212 °F

🌡️ Temperature Formulas:

  • Celsius to Kelvin: TK = T°C + 273.15
  • Kelvin to Celsius: T°C = TK - 273.15
  • Celsius to Fahrenheit: T°F = (9/5 × T°C) + 32 = (1.8 × T°C) + 32
  • Fahrenheit to Celsius: T°C = 5/9 × (T°F - 32)

👉 Dimensional Analysis (Factor-Label Method) የዩኒት ለውጥ ለማድረግ የምንጠቀምበት ዋና ስልት ሲሆን፤ የተሰጠውን እሴት በ (Desired Unit / Given Unit) በማባዛት የተፈለገውን ዩኒት ማግኘት ነው:: በሙቀት ለውጥ፦ Kelvin ለማግኘት ከ Celsius ላይ 273.15 እንደምራለን:: Fahrenheit ለማግኘት ደግሞ T°F = 1.8(T°C) + 32 ፎርሙላን እንጠቀማለን::

Worked Step-by-Step Chemistry Examples

Example 1.2: Significant Figures in Addition/Subtraction & Multiplication/Division

Problem: Perform the following calculations and express the answer with the correct number of significant figures:
a) 15.437 g + 2.01 g + 0.1245 g
b) (4.184 J/g·°C) × (24.5 g) × (12.35 °C)

Solution:

  • Part a (Addition):
    • 15.437 g (3 decimal places)
    • 2.01 g (2 decimal places) ← LEAST precise (fewest decimal places)
    • 0.1245 g (4 decimal places)
    • Unrounded Sum = 17.5715 g
    • Rounding to 2 decimal places:

>17.57 g
  • Part b (Multiplication):
    • 4.184 (4 sig figs)
    • 24.5 (3 sig figs) ← FEWEST sig figs
    • 12.35 (4 sig figs)
    • Unrounded Product = 1265.9867... J
    • Rounding to 3 sig figs:

>1.27 × 103 J

Example 1.3: Unit Conversion using Dimensional Analysis

Problem: The mass of a competition frisbee is 125 g. Convert its mass to kilograms (kg).

Solution:

  • Given: Mass = 125 g
  • Equivalence: 1 kg = 1000 g → Conversion factor = (1 kg / 1000 g)
  • Calculation:
    Mass in kg = 125 g × (1 kg / 1000 g) = 0.125 kg (3 sig figs)

Example 1.4: Multi-Step Unit Conversion (Speed Conversion)

Problem: A car travels at a speed of 60.0 miles per hour (mi/h). Convert this speed to meters per second (m/s). (Given: 1 mile = 1609.34 m, 1 hour = 3600 s).

Solution:

  • Given: Speed = 60.0 mi / 1 h
  • Conversion Factors: (1609.34 m / 1 mi) and (1 h / 3600 s)
  • Calculation:
    Speed = (60.0 mi / 1 h) × (1609.34 m / 1 mi) × (1 h / 3600 s)
    = (60.0 × 1609.34) / 3600 m/s
    = 96560.4 / 3600 m/s = 26.82233... m/s
  • Rounding to 3 sig figs (from 60.0): 26.8 m/s

Example 1.5: Temperature Scale Conversions

Problem: Normal human body temperature is 37.0 °C. Convert this temperature to:
a) Kelvin (K)
b) Degrees Fahrenheit (°F)

Solution:

  • Part a (Celsius to Kelvin):
    • Formula: TK = T°C + 273.15
    • TK = 37.0 + 273.15 = 310.15 K
    • Rounding to 1 decimal place: 310.2 K (or 310 K)
  • Part b (Celsius to Fahrenheit):
    • Formula: T°F = (1.8 × T°C) + 32
    • T°F = (1.8 × 37.0) + 32 = 66.6 + 32 = 98.6 °F
💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ በተደጋጋሚ የሚወጡ ወሳኝ ጥያቄዎችና ማታለሊያዎች፦
1. Leading Zeros Trick: 0.000450 g ስንት Significant Figure አለው? → 3 Sig Figs (4, 5 እና የመጨረሻዋ 0)! ከፊት ያሉ የመንደር ዜሮዎች አይቆጠሩም!
2. Addition vs Multiplication Rule Trick: ድመራ ላይ Sig Fig ሳትቆጥሩ Decimal Place ብቻ ተመልከቱ! ብዛት/ክፍፍል ላይ ደግሞ Sig Fig ተመልከቱ! ፈተና ላይ ሁለቱን ደባልቀው ያታልላሉ::
3. Temperature Conversion Trick: ከ °F ወደ K በቀጥታ መሄድ አይቻልም! አስቀድማችሁ ወደ °C ቀይሩ፣ ከዚያ ወደ K ቀይሩ::
4. Exact Numbers in Sig Figs: በ 1 inch = 2.54 cm ወይም 1 kg = 1000 g ውስጥ ያሉት ቁጥሮች Exact ስለሆኑ በካልኩሌሽን ወቅት Sig Fig መገደብ አይችሉም! Sig Fig የሚወሰነው በ Measured values ብቻ ነው::
